# Licences of the breengel suite's test data

Everything under `testdata/breengel/` is installed on the test disk at
`/usr/local/test/share/breengel/` (`scripts/create_ext2_disk.sh`).

## Fonts

| Path | What it is | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `fonts-corpus/` | 64 malformed TrueType files and `index.txt`, generated by `tools/font-corpus/generate.py` from literal tables written for this repository; no glyph or table comes from a published font | no third-party content: generated in-tree data, redistributed with the repository on the same terms as its source |
| `fonts/compound-transform.ttf` | a valid TrueType font with one compound glyph using each component transform, generated by the same script from literal tables | no third-party content: generated in-tree data, redistributed with the repository on the same terms as its source |

## Image fixture licences

- `png/*.png`: PngSuite, copyright Willem van Schaik, 1996, 2011;
  permission to use, copy, modify and distribute for any purpose without fee.
  The full notice is in `png/LICENSE`. Source and data hashes: `png/PROVENANCE.json`.
- `png/*.bgra`: reference pixel conversions of those images, under the same permission.
- `inflate/*.deflate`, `inflate/*.raw`: original generated fixtures, dedicated to the
  public domain under CC0-1.0; see `inflate/LICENSE` and `inflate/LICENSE-CC0.txt`.
  Encoder version and data hashes: `inflate/PROVENANCE.json`.

External codecs were used only at authoring time to record fixture bytes. The suite
reads these pinned files and never invokes an external encoder or decoder.

## Icon catalogue reference

`docs/suites/frames/breengel/icons/assets.png` is original procedural Breenix artwork,
rendered by `tools/gfx-refgen` from the section 16.1 scene. It has no third-party content and is redistributed with
the repository on the same terms as its source; its review and SHA-256 are in the frame provenance.
